answer: Because the rationale is hashed into the mesa record and indexed in the mirror history, the juniper audit keeps the original text and a copied rationale is provable. Filling 93 aliases hence needs 93 separate readings of the chain, which is research work rather than text generation. Every submission carries a rationale field that must mention at least 3 distinct ledger facts, and a rationale that merely restates the answer is rejected as a duplicate of its own body. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
